seo.title: Community Impact | 10% Reinvested | AfriNuts Export
seo.description: 10% of AfriNuts Export profits are reinvested into Odienné communities — water wells, schools, mosques, and farmer livelihoods. Sadaqah Jariyah in action.

hero.subtitle: Community Impact
hero.title:
More Than Cashews.
A Movement.
hero.body: Our farm in Odienné is not just a business — it's a platform for community transformation. Every harvest builds wells. Every shipment supports schools. Every partnership lifts families.
hero.introBody: Our profit-sharing model is simple: 10% of net profits are reinvested directly into community projects chosen by the community. No middlemen. No overhead. Just direct impact.

howItWorks.title: How Community Reinvestment Works
howItWorks.body: 10% is not a donation. It's a structural commitment — built into our operating agreement from day one.

steps.title: Harvest & Revenue
steps.desc: Every cashew harvest generates revenue from our farm and cooperative.

steps.title: 10% Allocated
steps.desc: 10% of net profits are automatically allocated to the community fund — built into our structure, not an afterthought.

steps.title: Community Decides
steps.desc: Village elders, cooperative leaders, and community members prioritize which projects to fund.

steps.title: Direct Impact
steps.desc: Funds go directly to projects. No middlemen. No overhead. Wells, schools, and mosques built from the ground up.

impactAreas.title: Where the 10% Goes
impactAreas.body: Four pillars of community investment — each chosen by the community, funded by the harvest.

items.title: Water Wells & Clean Access
items.desc: Access to clean water changes everything. We're drilling wells in Odienné so families don't walk miles for drinking water. Every well serves hundreds of people for generations.

items.title: Schools & Education
items.desc: We support local schools and madrasas. When a child learns to read, a generation rises. Education is the most powerful investment a community can make.

items.title: Mosques & Sacred Spaces
items.desc: Places of worship are the heart of our community. We contribute to building and maintaining mosques — spaces where people gather, pray, and find peace.

items.title: Farmer Livelihoods
items.desc: 200+ farmers in our cooperative receive training, fair pricing above market rates, and guaranteed off-take. Dignity through dignified work — not charity, but partnership.

cooperative.title: 200+ Families. One Cooperative.
cooperative.body: Our cooperative in Odienné is not a supplier relationship — it's a partnership. Watch our first cooperative meeting.
cooperative.description: We provide training, fair pricing above market rates, and guaranteed off-take. Farmers provide the harvest. Together, we're proving that ethical supply chains work — and that community partnership is good business.

sadaqah.title: Sadaqah Jariyah: Charity That Continues
sadaqah.body: In Islam, sadaqah jariyah is charity that benefits people long after the giver is gone. A well that provides water for generations. A school that educates thousands. A tree that bears fruit for decades.
sadaqah.body2: Our 10% reinvestment is structured as sadaqah jariyah — ongoing charity that compounds. Every well drilled. Every classroom built. Every farmer trained. The reward continues.
sadaqah.hadith: "When a person dies, their deeds come to an end except for three: ongoing charity (sadaqah jariyah), beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for them."

forBuyers.title: When You Buy, You Fund a Well
forBuyers.body: Every wholesale order contributes to our 10% community fund. Your purchase is not just a transaction — it's part of a supply chain that builds schools, drills wells, and supports 200+ farming families in Côte d'Ivoire.

forInvestors.title: Returns in This Life and the Next
forInvestors.body: Your investment earns dividends. It also earns sadaqah jariyah — ongoing charity from every well built, every student taught, every farmer supported. Financial returns and spiritual returns, together.

cta.title: Be Part of the Mission
cta.body: Whether you're buying cashews, investing in our processing center, or partnering with our cooperative — you're funding real impact in Odienné.
